seedanalysis-desc: Integrates Seed grain analysis into WikiCrop.
seedanalysis-subtitle: Upload a seed image to get counts, size measurements, previews, and QC warnings.
seedanalysis-select-image: Choose a JPG or PNG image
seedanalysis-error-service: Could not reach the Seed analysis service.
seedanalysis-error-preview: Could not read the selected image.
seedanalysis-reference-preview-help: Drag one line on the reference marker before analyzing.
seedanalysis-reference-empty: Drag one line on the reference marker
seedanalysis-suggested-reference-help: A measurement line was placed on the reference marker. Enter the real length in mm, adjust the handles if needed, then analyze again to convert results to millimeters.
seedanalysis-results-help: All figures are calculated from every detected grain in the image, not a sample of the first few grains.
seedanalysis-qc-ok: No suspect grains; all valid grains are included in statistics.
seedanalysis-qc-robust-note: $1 grains need review. Reported standard deviation is calculated from $2 valid grains after QC.
seedanalysis-qc-raw-warning: The suspect ratio is above 5%; raw standard deviation is retained and the image needs review.
seedanalysis-edit-suspects-help: Confirm a red region if it is a real grain; delete it if it is a wrong detection. Results, charts, and CSV are recalculated immediately.
seedanalysis-confirm-grain: Confirm this is a real grain
seedanalysis-delete-detection: Remove wrong detection from the result
seedanalysis-edit-preview-warning: Figures were updated, but the preview image could not be rebuilt.
seedanalysis-delete-success: Wrong detection removed and results recalculated.
seedanalysis-statistics-help: Choose length, width, or area to view the corresponding statistics and distribution.
seedanalysis-distribution-chart-help: Each column is the number of grains within a size interval.
seedanalysis-no-chart-data: There is not enough valid grain data to draw a chart.
